Entering "plastic bottle" → matches "recyclables"; the disposal points are emptying the residue and flattening it before disposal.
Entering "battery" → matches "hazardous waste"; it must go to a hazardous waste collection point and must never be mixed into other waste or kitchen waste.
Entering "leftovers" → matches "kitchen waste"; drain the water before disposal.
